say:3:1028303101:1.text: How did we arrive? By means of our sturdy legs, naturally, which have dutifully carried us far and wide...
say:3:1028303101:1.source_cn: 怎么来的？当然是依靠我们有力的腿脚，长途跋涉……
say:3:1028303101:1.male: How did we arrive? By means of our sturdy legs, naturally, which have dutifully carried us far and wide...
say:3:1028303101:1.female: How did we arrive? By means of our sturdy legs, naturally, which have dutifully carried us far and wide...

say:4:1028303102:1.text: Let me clarify: This area has been sealed off. So how did you get in?
say:4:1028303102:1.source_cn: 不……我的意思是，这附近已经被封锁了，你们是怎么进来的？

say:5:1028303103:1.text: Sealed off? No wonder there are so many patrols nearby... Well, that's not a big deal for archaeologists such as us, to be honest.
say:5:1028303103:1.source_cn: 封锁？怪不得附近有那么多巡逻队伍……啊，其实这对我们考...

say:6:1028303104:1.text: After all, we spend three-quarters of our lives trekking through the wilderness, facing down wild animals, famine, and all manners of exotic danger...
say:6:1028303104:1.source_cn: 毕竟，我们人生的四分之三都在野外跋山涉水，与野兽、饥饿...

say:7:1028303105:1.text: Three-quarters? Gali, you're exaggerating a bit.
say:7:1028303105:1.source_cn: 人生的四分之三？伽利，你也有点太夸张了。

say:8:1028303106:1.text: Alright... since you're friends of <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it's alright to remain here, but please be careful.
say:8:1028303106:1.male: Alright... since you're friends of <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it's alright to remain here, but please be careful.
say:8:1028303106:1.female: Alright... since you're friends of <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it's alright to remain here, but please be careful.

say:9:1028303107:1.text: Thank you. We'll look after ourselves.
say:9:1028303107:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，绿裔的朋友。我们会保护好自己的。
